in_marathi.name: Subhadip
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Bringer of Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Subhadip हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Subha means good, auspicious, and Dip means light. So, Subhadip means 'Bringer of Prosperity'. It is a name for a child who is destined to bring prosperity, happiness, and light to the lives of his parents and loved ones.

in_bengali.name: Subhadip

in_bengali.long_meaning: Subhadip একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Subha means good, auspicious, and Dip means light. So, Subhadip means 'Bringer of Prosperity'. It is a name for a child who is destined to bring prosperity, happiness, and light to the lives of his parents and loved ones.
